run_tombstones_monitor: start a background process that monitors SLURM job tombstone files and cancels jobs
run_tombstones_procedure: run the loop that watches for tombstone files and calls scancel on a SLURM job
create_tombstone_scancel: create a scancel tombstone file to trigger cancellation of a running SLURM job
create_tombstone_requeuehold: create a requeuehold tombstone file to trigger scontrol requeuehold on a SLURM job
review_JOB_STATE_CODES: review the list of SLURM job state codes used to validate job status
